messages.author: 409dfe1554e9c224
messages.subject: plot-type="h" equivalent?
parts:
Hi,

Is there an easy way to emulate

> myPois <- table(rpois(100,5))
> plot(myPois,type="h")

using ggplot2? Having the bars sit smack on the x-axis would be a bonus ...

Thanks for any hints!

Joh

messages.author: 5196f936ff792c35
messages.subject: Re: plot-type="h" equivalent?
parts:
Johannes,

Maybe a bit of a unintended use but...

myPois <- table(rpois(100,5)
mp<-as.data.frame(myPois)
p<-ggplot(data=mp, aes(x=Var1, y=Freq))
p+geom_linerange(aes(ymin=0, ymax=Freq))

Not sure about the start at 0 part. 

HTH, 

Brandon
